description.text: Design connectivity as a benefit with clear funding, employee eligibility, privacy boundaries and operating costs. Build a pilot your teams can assess.

intent: Evaluate and implement an employer-arranged mobile benefit with defined funding and operating responsibilities.
reader: Enterprise IT, procurement, finance and HR mobility stakeholders

snippet.query: What is connectivity as a benefit?
snippet.exactText: Connectivity as a benefit is an employer-arranged program that gives employees access to mobile service under a defined funding and support policy. Employees, employers or both may pay for the service. The program needs clear eligibility, subscription ownership, privacy boundaries and exit rules before a discounted plan becomes a useful workplace benefit.
